title: Phosphoric acid based geopolymer foam-activated carbon composite for methylene blue adsorption: isotherm, kinetics, thermodynamics, and machine learning studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1989-2010
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05782A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muhammad Irfan Khan, Suriati Sufian, Farrukh Hassan, Rashid Shamsuddin, Muhammad Farooq
The ACP adsorbent, a blend of activated carbon and phosphoric acid-based geopolymer foam, showed high methylene blue adsorption efficiency, aligning with the Langmuir isotherm, PSO kinetics, and ANN-based predictions.
